falseFriends.actual: Use 'i vërtetë' or 'real', not 'aktual' (which means 'current/topical' from Italian 'attuale')
falseFriends.fabric: Use 'pëlhurë' or 'stofë', not 'fabrikë' (which means 'factory'). Critical given Albania's dominant textile industry.
falseFriends.effective: Use 'efektiv/efektivitet' for effectiveness, NOT 'efikas/efikasitet' (which means efficiency). OEE measures effectiveness.
falseFriends.sensible: Use 'i arsyeshëm' or 'praktik', not 'sensibël' (which means 'sensitive' from Italian 'sensibile')
falseFriends.station: Use 'stacion pune' or 'stacion prodhimi' for workstation. Bare 'stacion' is ambiguous (train/bus/work).

grammarNotes.postposedArticle: Definite article is suffix: 'fabrikë' (a factory) → 'fabrika' (the factory). Foreign acronyms hyphenated: 'OEE-ja' (the OEE), 'KPI-të' (the KPIs).
grammarNotes.caseSystem: 5 cases (nom, gen, dat, acc, abl). Genitive requires linking particle i/e/të/së: 'koha e ciklit' (cycle time). Missing particle is a common error.
grammarNotes.twoGenders: Masculine and feminine. Technical loanwords preserve source gender. Adjectives agree: 'njësi primare' (f+f), 'prodhim i mirë' (m+linker+m).
grammarNotes.schwaPhonemic: Letter ë (schwa) is distinct phoneme — must not be omitted. 'Fabrikë' ≠ 'fabrika' (definite vs indefinite).
grammarNotes.numberFormatting: Decimal: comma (,). Thousands: period (.). '85,5%'. '1.000 njësi'. Continental European convention.
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: In compound noun phrases with genitive particle (e/të/i/së), only the HEAD noun pluralizes. The genitive modifier stays SINGULAR. CORRECT: 'shkaqet e humbjes së shpejtësisë' (causes + of loss [gen.sg] + of speed [gen.sg]). WRONG: 'shkaqet e humbjeve të shpejtësisë' (causes + of losses [gen.pl] + of speed). The modifier 'humbjes' names the concept of speed loss; only the head noun counts items.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: OEE (English) standard. No local Albanian acronym exists.
industryContext.dominantSectors: Textiles/garments (~44% of exports, ~1000 companies, ~90,000 workers), footwear, food processing, construction materials
industryContext.italianInfluence: Italian investment dominates Albanian manufacturing (fason/cut-make-trim). Italian terminology influences Albanian technical vocabulary.
standardsUsed: SSH standards (aligned with EU harmonized standards)

commonMistakes: Using 'efikasiteti' (efficiency) instead of 'efektiviteti' (effectiveness) for OEE — OEE measures effectiveness, not efficiency
Omitting ë (schwa) — phonemically distinct and mandatory. 'ndërrimi' not 'ndrrimi'
Using 'mbeturinë' (general waste) for manufacturing scrap — consider 'brak' or 'skart' in quality context
Missing genitive particle: 'koha ciklit' (WRONG) vs 'koha e ciklit' (CORRECT)
Using informal 'ti' instead of formal 'Ju' in B2B software
Using 'aktual' for 'actual/real' instead of 'i vërtetë' or 'real'

Pluralizing the modifier in compound noun phrases: 'shkaqet e humbjeve të shpejtësisë' (WRONG — 'humbjeve' is genitive plural) instead of 'shkaqet e humbjes së shpejtësisë' (CORRECT — 'humbjes' is genitive singular). The modifier names the category; only the head noun takes plural
notes: OEE (English) standard. Unique Indo-European language. Latin script with ë, ç. Formal 'Ju'. Postposed articles. Textile/garment industry dominant. P95 expansion 1.94x. Full term available for expansion.
